messages:
kevin: Heads-up — opened a PR for the Azure Marketplace reference architecture + Terraform module for LLM inference. Need a quick compatibility QA before we hand to partner.eng and marketplace ops. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refkit/pull/1234 :eyes:

maria: nice, link works. what are the specific test items you want validated? packaging, ARM64 support, or also the sample deploy flow?

kevin: all of the above. checklist in the PR description but tl;dr: 1) terraform module lint + fmt 2) multi-arch provider (graviton/x86) 3) ARM64 image references and quantized model bundle 4) marketplace metadata (offer/plan) 5) smoke deploy to a test subscription 6) docs snippet for quickstart

nina: I can run smoke deploys tomorrow into our test-sub-az-east. Do you have a minimal tfvars for the smoke run?

kevin: added a small example tfvars in the PR: 
```
resource_group = "refkit-qa-rg"
region = "eastus2"
instance_type = "Standard_ND40rs_v2" # for GPU path
model_package = "s3://redwood-models/quantized/llm-v1-8bit"
```

maria: quick note — marketplace packaging requires offer.json version and vmSizes mapping. I put a checklist comment on the PR for that. Also need license text for the sample model bundle (even if placeholder).

raj: for ARM64 runtime compatibility, add an explicit provider_alias block and a tiny validation module that calls:
```hcl
provider "azurerm" { alias = "arm" features {} }
module "arm_validation" { source = "./modules/validation" providers = { azurerm = azurerm.arm } }
```
This guards the build when the deployer is on Graviton-backed VMs.

kevin: good call. I'll push a commit with the provider_alias and the package/license placeholders.

ci-bot: lint/terraform — FAILED on 1 file: modules/marketplace/main.tf (missing required variable descriptions). See details: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/4321009876/ci/987

nina: I can fix the lint errors as part of the smoke run patch. small change, will open a follow-up PR and link here.

maria: also check the sample docs include the marketplace SKU mapping and a note on known latency/cost tradeoffs for the GPU vs CPU plan. Partners ask for that up-front. :thumbsup:

kevin: agreed — we'll add a quick table in the README and call out recommended quantization profiles per SKU. Will ping partner-eng when CI green.

raj: can someone from packaging team validate the offer metadata once CI passes? I can reach out to jules from marketplace ops.

kevin: yes pls. tagging jules in partner-eng thread after CI. thanks all. :shipit:

nina: starting smoke run now, will report back with timestamps and logs in this thread.

ci-bot: lint/terraform — PASSED. smoke-deploy job queued: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/4321009876/ci/991

kevin: awesome — leaving this open until packaging sign-off and partner-eng accepts the refkit. will update PR with the packaging checklist items and the minimal tfvars example.
